messages:
emily: Customer on dedicated saw double billing after a quick disconnect/reconnect. filing here — short notes + logs.

rao: please paste session id and the two billing tx ids.

emily: sess=sess_a1. provisional billed 45 tokens at 15:02:10, confirmed billed 40 tokens at 15:02:36. customer reported total 85.

emily: logs:
```
[router] stream_start sess=sess_a1 user=acct_77
[runtime] soft_snapshot sess=sess_a1 tokens=45 provisional=true snap=snap_21
[billing] provisional tx=ptx_11 acct=acct_77 tokens=45
[client] reconnect sess=sess_a1 replay=true tool=tc_3
[router] forward req=req_900 (no-snap)
[billing] confirm tx=ctx_12 acct=acct_77 tokens=40
```

sam: looks like router dropped the snap id on replay so billing treated them separately.

emily: short-term ideas: 1) router forward snapshot/toolcall id as header 2) billing accept snapshot pointer and reconcile provisional->confirmed 3) console mark provisional rows and expose reconcile button.

rao: also add execution_kind telemetry (fresh|cached|replay) so billing can decide refunds safely. only auto-refund when execution_kind!=fresh.

billing-bot: Created BILL-1301 "reconcile provisional/confirmed on stream replay" assigned to @sam.

ops-bot: Incident INC-8102 created; tags: routing,billing,console.

console-bot: I can add provisional highlight + "reconcile" CTA in the ledger today; will include raw tx links.

sam: decision: router header passthrough (x-snapshot-id) -> @rao (1d); billing reconcile + guarded refund -> @sam (2-3d); console CTA -> @console-bot (1d). I'll add acceptance test: simulate soft-snapshot then replay and assert net charge == confirmed after reconcile refund when execution_kind!=fresh.

emily: thanks all — I'll reach out to the customer about refund path and attach reproducible script. ping when PRs are up. :thumbsup:
